build_PPOAgent_nets: build the actor and critic neural networks for the PPOAgent using TensorFlow placeholders and variable scopes
build_PPOAgent_losses: build the PPO actor and critic loss functions with ratio clipping and weight decay support
train_PPOAgent_step: train the PPOAgent for one update step using replay buffer data and mini-batch gradient updates
decide_PPOAgent_action: decide an action from the PPOAgent given a state and optional goal with exploration noise
update_PPOAgent_actor_stepsize: update the PPOAgent actor stepsize dynamically based on the clip fraction and target clip tolerance
